description: Team Horizon-x is a forward-thinking group of innovators participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge in Addis Ababa. Focused on pushing boundaries and exploring new frontiers, the team combines local perspective with global space science to solve complex challenges.
summary:
gadaspace (by Team Horizon-X) is an interactive deep-space radiation protection, bio-dosimetry, and spacecraft shielding platform designed to keep astronauts healthy on Artemis lunar and Mars missions.

Deep-space missions face two critical challenges: heavy metallic hulls (like thick lead) trigger secondary nuclear spallation neutrons inside the crew cabin, while single silicon detectors miss ~92% of uncharged neutrons—underestimating astronaut dose by 21.4%. Inspired by the consensus principles of the Oromo Gadaa system, gadaspace solves both problems in one closed-loop system:

Bio-Hybrid Graded-Z Shielding & Active Magnetosphere: Models BeCO, HDPE, ¹⁵⁷Gd-MXene (255,000-barn thermal neutron capture), radiotrophic fungal melanin, and superconducting magnetic deflection.
5-Detector Kalman Consensus: Fuses Silicon, TEPC, CsI scintillator, ¹⁵⁷Gd/³He neutron, and TLD sensors with NASA OLTARIS priors (±4.8% RMSE).
Smart Spacesuit & Real-Time Alerts: Features a 3D spacesuit with magnetic deflection and live Geiger-style audio clicks when radiation spikes, plus dual Student/Explorer and Expert Flight Surgeon modes powered by live NOAA/NASA satellite telemetry.
details:
1. Why We Chose the Name "gadaspace" (Creativity & Heritage)

The name gadaspace ("Where Ancient Heritage Meets Cosmic Horizons") is inspired by the UNESCO-inscribed Oromo Gadaa system—an indigenous governance and knowledge tradition built on participatory consensus, cosmic timekeeping (Ayaantuu), justice, and ethical stewardship (Safuu). Instead of using heritage only as a title, we translated four Gadaa pillars directly into our aerospace engineering architecture:

  • Gumii Consensus → 5-Detector Kalman Sensor Fusion: Under the sacred Odaa sycamore tree, the Gumii assembly reconciles diverse voices so no single blind spot endangers the community. In gadaspace, our Inverse-Variance Kalman/Bayesian filter fuses 5 different radiation detectors with NASA OLTARIS priors so no single sensor failure or blind spot misleads the crew.
  • Bokkuu (Balance & Justice) → 4-Way Spacecraft Trade-Off: Held by the Abbaa Gadaa as a symbol that power must never override human welfare, the Bokkuu inspires our Pareto trade-off engine balancing launch mass (kg), electrical power (kW), and cost while strictly protecting astronauts under the NASA-STD-3001 (250 mSv) limit.
  • Ayaantuu (Cosmic Timekeeping) → 72-Hour Solar Storm Early Warning: Translates traditional sky-watching into real-time Parker Spiral arrival predictions from live NOAA satellites.
  • Safuu (Ecological & Human Stewardship) → Bio-Hybrid Protection: Replaces toxic, spallation-prone heavy lead with sustainable BeCO, HDPE, ¹⁵⁷Gd-MXene, and radiotrophic fungal melanin.

2. What It Does & How It Works

gadaspace is a real-time deep-space radiation protection, bio-dosimetry, and mission-planning digital twin built to keep astronauts healthy on Artemis lunar and Mars missions:

  • Solves the Heavy-Metal Spallation Trap (3-Layer Graded-Z Bio-Hybrid Shield): Thick lead/steel armor shatters incoming relativistic Galactic Cosmic Rays (⁵⁶Fe ions) into deadly secondary neutrons inside the crew cabin. gadaspace models a lightweight 3-layer stack (BeCO / outer ion stripper → HDPE proton moderator → ¹⁵⁷Gd-MXene [255,000-barn thermal neutron capture] + self-healing radiotrophic fungal melanin) paired with active magnetic deflection.
  • Solves Single-Sensor Neutron Blindness (5-Detector Kalman Consensus): Standard silicon detectors miss ~92% of uncharged neutrons (-21.4% dose underestimation). Our Kalman/Bayesian filter combines Silicon (DET-01-SI), TEPC (DET-02-TEPC), CsI Scintillator (DET-03-CSI), ¹⁵⁷Gd/³He Neutron (DET-04-NEUT), and Passive TLD (DET-05-TLD) into one unified reading with ±4.8% RMSE, even if a sensor drops out during a solar storm.
    • Direct Hohmann TLI: 3.2 days, 3.8 mSv total, 18.4 mSv/hr peak through the inner proton belt (L = 1.5–2.2).
    • Polar High-Inclination Bypass (68.5°): 4.6 days, 1.4 mSv total, 0.95 mSv/hr peak—escaping over Earth's open magnetic poles to cut total transit radiation by 63%.
    • WSB Low-Energy Cargo Detour: 94 days, 136 mSv total, 0.068 mSv/hr peak.
  • 3D Living Cell & DNA Bio-Dosimetry: Computes exact ICRP-60 Quality Factor Q(LET), organ-weighted effective dose, and DNA Double-Strand Break (DSB) risk against NASA-STD-3001 limits.
  • Live NOAA SWPC Space Weather Forecasting: Streams 6 live JSON feeds from GOES-18/19 (Protons, Electrons, X-Rays), DSCOVR L1 (Solar Wind & IMF Bz), and Solar Cycle Indices, computing Parker Spiral storm arrival windows (100 MeV vs. 10 MeV) and matching historical NASA/NOAA storm analogs.

3. Benefits, Intended Impact & Factors Considered

  • Protecting Astronaut Health: Prevents secondary neutron cascades, cuts cumulative crew dose, and provides instant audio/suit-shield response during Solar Energetic Particle (SEP) storms.
    1. Student & Explorer Mode: Left-hand vertical navigation, zero intimidating equations, interactive 3D Smart Suit, 3D Space Highway, 3D DNA cell, and plain-English takeaways.
    2. Expert Flight Surgeon Mode: Full differential equations, 4-way Pareto optimization, multi-detector telemetry fusion, and NASA dataset validation.
  • Engineering Trade-Offs Considered: Launch mass vs. attenuation (Tsiolkovsky rocket penalty), sensor saturation/clipping during X-class flares, eyes-free EVA safety, and real-time browser performance.

4. Tools, Coding Languages, Hardware & Software Used

  • Languages & Web Stack: JavaScript (ES Modules), React 19, HTML5, CSS3, Vite, Python (Streamlit prototype).
  • 3D Graphics, Charts & Audio: Three.js (3D habitat, trajectories, DNA double-helix, Smart Spacesuit), Plotly.js, Lucide Icons, Web Audio API (real-time Geiger sonification), PptxGenJS.
  • Hardware / Sensor Integration: Web Serial / WebUSB CMOS camera & external multi-detector CSV ingestion (SensorBridge, sample_gadaspace_multidetector_telemetry.csv).
  • Hosting & Version Control: Git/GitHub (https://github.com/nafkunasefa1-hub/gadaaspace), ShipStatic (https://tactile-beam-gk59uwp.shipstatic.com).
  • SI Acknowledgment: Super Intelligence (SI) coding tools were used to accelerate React/Three.js UI implementation, refactoring, and formatting; all architecture, Gadaa consensus mapping, and challenge design were created and verified by Team Horizon-X.
